title: Valley of the Dolls
author: Jacqueline Susann
summary: Three women, Anne, Neely and Jennifer, chase success in New York and Hollywood from the 1940s to the 1960s. Fame, men and a reliance on pills slowly take their toll on each of them.
readIf: you enjoy glossy, scandalous mid-century melodrama about showbusiness and its costs.
skipIf: you dislike dated attitudes or soapy stories where nearly everyone ends up in trouble.
